channel.title: WillowinWorld Devlog
channel.description: Latest production notes for WillowinWorld mobile games.

item.title: Nature Seed: Level 2 restoration and stability pass
item.description: Level 2 now uses its production background pair, with more reliable level setup, collision checks and completion feedback.

item.title: Candy Shop: Production menu and HUD pass
item.description: Main menu, level selection, HUD controls and command icons now share one visual language; additional in-engine stress tests cover the updated flow.

item.title: Paint Blasters: Physics and effect stability pass
item.description: Projectile behavior, Match-3 resolution and hit effects were tested and tightened for more consistent combo outcomes.

item.title: Ball is God?!: World surfaces and hazard validation
item.description: Character presentation, deterministic generation and thorn hazards received a coordinated visual and production-validation pass.
